entries.title: City Harvest hosts Agriculture Secretary Vilsack and Environmental acting Deputy Meiberg (20150916-OSEC-LSC-1465).jpg
entries.description: Credit Suisse's City Harvest volunteers collect produce and other foods from a participating farmers’ market in a process that City Harvest calls a “Greenmarket Rescue” at the Union Square in New York City, NY on Wednesday, Sep. 16, 2015. On this day, the team collected more than 5,000 pounds of food. This fresh food was then immediately delivered in a City Harvest refrigerated truck, to a Brooklyn food pantry. USDA photo by Lance Cheung.
entries.creator: USDAgov

entries.title: Cargo containers (5945899601).jpg
entries.description: Vancouver waterfont, near Centennial Pier. The container shipping trade between Asia and the West Coast has exploded since the 1980s when I did a school project on the Port of Vancouver. The major area of development has been the integration of rail services with container shipping.
entries.creator: Roy Luck

entries.title: Agriculture Secretary Vilsack at Farm Broadcasters in KC (20161110-OSEC-KP-0004).jpg
entries.description: Agriculture Secretary Tom Vilsack delivers remarks to the 73rd annual National Association of Farm Broadcasting (NAFB) convention.
